function.name: state
function.description: Inspect your own body: position, hands, backpack, last action result, what is around your cell, and the current world digest.

function.name: scan
function.description: Block census of a box around a cell: x spans x±4r, z spans z±4r, y spans y..y+2r (up to 1M cells; r=16 is the practical max). It only sees AT OR ABOVE the given y - it cannot see underground. For something below the surface, or for a specific material, use the query tool with a code filter instead.

function.name: screenshot
function.description: Save a view from your body's perspective to the observation directory.

function.name: events
function.description: Recent actor-tagged activity (who did what, last n events).

function.name: autonomy
function.description: Read the current autonomy preset. It is world-owned: you read it, you cannot change it.

function.name: mission
function.description: Dispatch a BACKGROUND job through the job system - returns at once, 90-minute cap, the settlement stays conversable. Call with NO goal to report the running/finished state instead. Goal grammar: 'gather <material> xN [tool <item>] [at <x,y,z>]' (BASICS - the world provides however it provides: a loose ground item (flint, a dropped stick) is picked up, a plant (cattail/tallplant-*) is broken - with a knife or scythe in the bot's hand the reed keeps its root and regrows, without one it is destroyed, a crop is harvested, a bush picked; 'harvest' is the same verb), 'mine <material> xN', 'sow <crop> xN at <site>' (complete endogenous chain - it harvests its own seed), 'forage <bush> xN at <x,y,z>' (fruitingbush-* family), 'build <material> xN at <site>' (N blocks as a ring platform; add 'supply external' if the bot holds none), 'build-plan <plan-id> at <site>' (a whole building from the library - never 'build <plan-id>'), 'goto <player>' (bring the selected bots to the player's live position). Coordinates in a goal are space-separated numbers.

goal.description: the goal line (omit to query mission status)

function.name: pots
function.description: Dispatch the POT-WORK FOOD CHAIN as one background mission: clay -> clayform table -> raw crucible -> pit-kiln firing -> fired crucible -> firepit cooking -> the bot eats. It gives the bot its own clay and meat as the only external input; it cooks ONE meat per fire load (the 1.22 firepit drops a second meat in the same load - engine quirk, not a bug). All three cells are REQUIRED: the air cell the clayform table goes in, the floor of a 1-deep hole (the pit kiln), the firepit cell. They live at the base - query the base zone first if you do not have them.

form_at.description: [x,y,z] air cell for the clayform table

function.name: query
function.description: What is in a NAMED ZONE or around a point: a compact digest (counts plus a capped code/position list). target: a zone name, or two coordinates 'x z' (an optional third number is the radius; the coordinate form walks your body there first). mode: blocks | entities | all (default all). code: substring filter - the radius scan is centred on your body and DOES see underground, so 'code: ore-flint' finds buried veins that a scan cannot.

function.name: zone
function.description: Named rectangular world regions (the registry) - the settlement and per-building areas the operator declares: sub: 'list' | 'show <name>' (read) | 'define <name> x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2' | 'remove <name>' | 'rename <old> <new>' (writes are free-only autonomy). 'show' also highlights the zone's wireframe for the operator.

function.name: crew
function.description: Size the worker roster (your body excluded) to exactly n: it recruits if short, retires the newest if over (hard cap 8). The ONE way to change crew size - never raw spawn/despawn.

function.name: command
function.description: A direct harness command (free autonomy only). Risky ones: 'despawn <id>' removes EXACTLY the bot with that id - if the reply names a different id or errors, STOP and report verbatim, never 'repair' with a spawn. 'spawn' adds a new bot - a creation act, never a retry mechanism.

function.name: follow
function.description: The follow TOGGLE. mode 'me': your body walks to the operator and stays with them; 'all': the whole crew; 'off': release (the mod tracks the player's live position until off; idle bots only, never interrupts running work).

function.name: vocab
function.description: The name<->code resolver: the operator says a human word ("cattail", "flint", "stick", "cranberry"), the game knows codes. Queries the LIVE in-game registry (self-syncing across game updates) and returns matching codes + names + measured drop lists. Call it for any resource word that is not on the hot list before dispatching a gather/mine mission.

function.name: preview
function.description: The TRANSPARENT BLUEPRINT: before a build is commenced, show the whole building plan as translucent cubes at a ground anchor (nothing is placed - the operator sees it in VNC/webui; the reply reports willPlace/collision/already counts). ALWAYS preview a plan before proposing to build it; never build what the operator has not seen. plan: a library name (see 'build-plan'); origin: 'x y z'.
